# Google-Extended and Applebot-Extended are robots.txt-only opt-out tokens, not real crawlers:
# Google/Apple fetch pages with the normal Googlebot/Applebot user agent and consult these
# tokens server-side to decide whether that content may be used for AI training. They can't be
# blocked by User-Agent at the web server level (see web/.htaccess and deployment/nginx.conf.*),
# this is the only place they take effect.
User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Disallow: /
